title: Exploration and access to electronic data assets
related_application_signals: priority benefit of US provisional application 63/384,330 filed 2022-11-18
related granted US family includes US12353582B2
earlier publication in the family includes US20240169082A1

source_provenance.note: Ephemeral request-token parameters are intentionally not persisted.

classification_signals: G06F21/604 tools and structures for administering access control
G06F21/62 platform-based protection of access to data
G06F21/6218 access control for files, objects, distributed file systems, or databases
G06F21/6227 access protection concerning records, types, queries, or data structure
publicly_described_functional_concepts: guided exploration of summarized or aggregated dataset information without exposing underlying data items
iterative cohort filtering using dataset or record characteristics before access is granted
purpose-based access requests associated with a declared investigation or use purpose
authorization workflows that involve dataset permission levels and data-owner approval
generation of a dedicated investigation dataset containing only authorized data items
self-contained investigation workspaces that isolate purpose-authorized data
version history and metadata sufficient to reproduce an earlier investigation dataset
controlled updates or feeds from source datasets into an approved investigation workspace
governance objects linking users, purposes, datasets, requests, owners, and approvals
auditability of why access was requested, approved, used, updated, revoked, or expired

scope_model.analysis_loop: browse only permitted summaries -> iteratively filter a candidate cohort -> declare purpose -> evaluate policy and required owners -> collect approvals -> materialize only authorized data into an isolated workspace -> preserve versions and provenance -> optionally refresh through governed feeds -> expire or revoke access when policy requires
building_patterns_relevant_to_independen: separate data discovery permission from underlying record access permission
use privacy-preserving summaries or aggregates for pre-authorization exploration
make purpose a first-class object carried through request, approval, workspace, and audit events
materialize the minimum authorized subset instead of granting broad source-system access
separate source datasets from investigation copies or references using an isolated workspace boundary
record owner approvals, policy decisions, timestamps, purpose, filters, and source versions with every workspace
support explicit expiration, revocation, and refresh decisions rather than indefinite access
maintain immutable or versioned investigation manifests so prior analyses can be reproduced
expose sensitivity and governance metadata without revealing protected record values
require policy checks whenever a workspace receives new or modified source data

independent_claim_themes: filtering electronic data assets using summarized information while withholding underlying data items
receiving a purpose-based request for selected data assets and determining authorization for that purpose
generating an investigation dataset from purpose-authorized data and providing controlled access to it
dependent themes include aggregated statistics, dynamic visual filtering, isolated workspaces, reproducibility metadata, sensitivity display, governed updates, and version history
claim_scope_signals.legal_scope_rule: Patent scope depends on the controlling claims, prosecution history, legal status, and jurisdiction. This record is an engineering research abstraction only.

family_signals.territorial_status_rule: Do not infer worldwide rights or freedom to operate from this US publication or family. Recheck controlling claims and legal status in each relevant jurisdiction before legal or commercial decisions.

design_divergence_defaults: use independently designed purpose, request, approval, and workspace object schemas
use independently selected aggregation and privacy-preserving summary techniques
separate discovery, approval, provisioning, refresh, and revocation into explicit services
record an immutable workspace manifest instead of relying on implicit source-system state
bind every restricted-data read to a current policy decision and purpose context
enforce minimum-necessary access with independently designed slicing and policy rules
keep authorization decisions outside the language model and inside deterministic policy services

mandatory_safety_boundaries: do not expose restricted record values during summary-only discovery
no restricted-data access without current authorization and purpose context
no policy or data-owner approval bypass
explicit workspace isolation for restricted datasets
human privacy/legal review for high-risk personal or regulated data deployments
